name: Greedy Merging for VV Codes
definition: A method for constructing Variable-length Variable-length (VV) codes by iteratively merging the least-probable leaf in a parse tree to reduce code length, aiming to minimize coding rate.
summary: Greedy merging constructs Variable-length Variable-length codes by iteratively merging the least-probable leaf to reduce code length, offering a computationally efficient but suboptimal alternative to exhaustive search.
